scenarios.name: Dock and resize Appearance Browser on the right

scenario_steps.name: Appearance Browser is floating over the workspace
the user drags the Appearance Browser title bar to the far right workspace edge
Appearance Browser docks along the right edge
the Model Browser remains visible on the left
the viewport occupies the space between both browser panels
the active part document remains open
the user drags the shared boundary toward the viewport to widen Appearance Browser
the view orientation control remains visible in the viewport
the user restores the boundary to its earlier position
the docked panel and viewport return to their earlier proportions
